The races identify the *net* cost of one step harder over a whole stint, holding stint length and race phase fixed: Suzuka 2023 +0.314 +/- 0.517 s [not used: standard error 0.517 s > 0.15 s (pre-2026 measurement, too imprecise to pool)]; Suzuka 2024 +0.048 +/- 0.217 s [not used: standard error 0.217 s > 0.15 s (pre-2026 measurement, too imprecise to pool)]; Suzuka 2025 +0.020 +/- 0.136 s; australia-2026 +0.317 +/- 0.345 s; barcelona-2026 +0.060 +/- 0.336 s; austria-2026 +0.106 +/- 0.295 s; belgium-2026 +0.075 +/- 0.323 s; hungary-2026 -0.010 +/- 0.327 s; italy-2026 +0.173 +/- 0.354 s -> pooled +0.069 +/- 0.096 s per step. The model's fresh-tyre offsets are calibrated so that, with its own degradation ladder, it reproduces this net at the stint length it recommends.
